title: kbid.py add's stale-lock clear can take a live holder's lock, so two adds hold the sources lock at once after a crash
goal: _clear_stale in _tools/kbid.py never moves aside a lock a live writer made after the waiter judged the old one stale (a waiter that stat'ed a stale lock later os.replace's whatever sits at the name, possibly a fresh lock; a third writer can create the lock before os.link restores it, and a failed link is swallowed), so concurrent adds after a crashed writer's stale lock neither drop a row nor tear the .tmp; found by the SP-ilqhjn3k review (reading _tools/kbid.py:323)

run: import sys,os,tempfile;sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import kbid;d=tempfile.mkdtemp();lock=os.path.join(d,'s.lock');open(lock,'w').write('C');o=os.link;os.link=lambda a,b:(open(b,'w').write('D'),o(a,b))[1];kbid._clear_stale(lock);os.link=o;t=open(lock).read();print('lock now held by',t);sys.exit(1 if t!='C' else 0)

notes: Merged from BG-u7gtwn5s “kbid.py add leaks its sources lock when writing the lock file fails, and .gitignore does not list the lock or its clear names” at the 2026-10-13 draft triage: Reproduces (lock left after a failed os.fdopen) but is the same _sources_lock/_clear_stale code of kbid.py and the same SP-ilqhjn3k review as BG-h6aqngbp. Must absorb: remove the created lock when fdopen or the owner-line write raises, and list _sources.csv.lock and _sources.csv.lock.clear.* in .gitignore (currently no lock entry). Its goal: _sources_lock in _tools/kbid.py removes the lock it created when os.fdopen or the write of its owner line raises (or the process is interrupted before the try), so the next add does not stall for LOCK_STALE_S, and .gitignore lists _sources.csv.lock and _sources.csv.lock.clear.*; found by the SP-ilqhjn3k review (reading _tools/kbid.py:366) Its repro: {"run": ["python3", "-c", "import sys,os,tempfile;sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import kbid;d=tempfile.mkdtemp();p=os.path.join(d,'_sources.csv');f=os.fdopen;os.fdopen=lambda *a,**k:(_ for _ in ()).throw(OSError('planted'));exec('try:\\n with kbid._sources_lock(p,p): pass\\nexcept OSError: pass');os.fdopen=f;left=os.path.exists(p+'.lock');print('lock left after a failed write:',left);sys.exit(1 if left else 0)"]} Its touches: _tools/kbid.py, _tools/test_redact.py, .gitignore
